eights-atlas.description: Living Agent-BOM Atlas — read-only MCP bridge consumer for TheEights. Localhost-only (127.0.0.1) GET-only HTTP facade over the existing daemon MCP stdio boundary. Fixed read-only envelope (actor eights-atlas, project TheEights, domain infra, empty scope). Hard read-only tool whitelist + forbidden-verb denylist. No daemon/src modification, no new daemon surface; every proxied read is audited.
